scope: Competence criteria 1-5 and transfer/retention criterion 10 from authenticated CSV only; no overall 13-criterion acceptance.
csv_hash_authentication: Each local CSV byte count and SHA256 matches DATA_PROVENANCE and its entry in ROOT_SHA256SUMS; manifest SHA matches provenance. ZIP/whole-checkpoint authentication is a separate review.

ANALYSIS_RAW.json.role: Post-calculation agreement check only; not used as input to independent metric computation.

method.implementation: Independent inline arithmetic; no arena module imported or executed and no call to analyze/paired_contrast. Frozen A source inspected as text/AST.
method.bootstrap: Paired hierarchical percentile bootstrap: resample 3 model replicas first, then 20 paired environment indices within each selected model; treatment/control share draws. Random baseline seed0 is reused for each replica as preregistered.
method.label_salt: Frozen A label SHA256 first8 bytes big-endian XOR base seed; exact labels are recorded per contrast.
method.pass_condition: Mean gain >= random margin (or >=0 for untrained), percentile CI lower >0, and at least2/3 positive per-model gains. Interception and collision/distance pool numerator/denominator before differencing.

opportunity_exposure.limitation: Exposure counts alone do not show successful escape or pursuit.

scenario_audit.reason: No scenario/trajectory receipt was within this CSV-only audit.

curve_throttle_brake_audit.reason: No trajectory/control receipt was within this CSV-only audit.

target_training_auc.definition: Each episode/final partial episode progress multiplied by steps since preceding right endpoint, divided by exactly 60000 target interactions; exploratory training returns.

holdout_and_equal_budget.reason: Curves cover exactly 60000 steps each; independent checkpoint/replay holdout receipts are outside this CSV-only audit.

limitations: Only three independently fitted model replicas; hierarchical intervals are descriptive preregistered evidence and do not support a universal-game claim.
Numerical success in a submetric is retained even if another conjunctive requirement fails; FAIL does not mean absence of all learned ability.

CSV-only audit cannot authenticate checkpoint internals, replay held-out exclusions, scenario/trajectory behavior or demonstration/recovery/delivery receipts. Those remain separate evidence requirements.
No seeds, thresholds, bootstrap resampling hierarchy, negative outcomes, or evaluation cells were added, removed or selected.
The audit does not grant coordinated final acceptance or claim completion of criterion13.
